name: lab-panel
description: Side panel: a colorful file tree that lights up the files Claude reads and edits, a replay of the last turn's edits, and note tabs you can mark up

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the panel when a session starts. Off: open it with /panel.

tabsDir.title: Tabs folder
tabsDir.description: Where your note tabs are kept. Empty: ~/.claude/choboza-pack/panel

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd = file-type icons (needs a Nerd Font). plain = simple letters, for when icons show as boxes.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language. auto = your system language.
